aAxisReview.stopAttribution: the newest user.message carrying a selection fact is authoritative (same as runner runSelection); a model-only selection leaves the session unbound and is never attributed to an older agent/team binding
aAxisReview.sessionWindow: bounded at 5x200=1000 most recently active sessions; when the server still has more the command warns on stderr and the help/manifest disclose the boundary
aAxisReview.eventPaging: requests kernel.MaxEventPage and continues while a page is full; a page-bound hit fails closed instead of attributing a stale binding

e2e.idleStop: nonzero, no active run (no fake cancellation)
e2e.teamSave: create revision=1, update revision=2, show-export round-trip revision=3, id-less save exit 2
e2e.captainStop: team run stopped through its captain, run.finished status=cancelled
e2e.referenceProtection: agent delete of a seated member is 409 agent_in_use with the team listed

isolation.database: dedicated DROP/CREATE database, dropped on exit

blocked.teamDeleteSessionReferenceProtection: blocked: no sessions.agent/team binding column; needs keel-harness-v2 W2-1 groups/session_placement (unimplemented) or RUNTIME-PLAN candidate B
